Use the N–mm–MPa unit system throughout.
Apply Euler–Bernoulli beam theory (small deflection, linear elastic).
Model a cantilever beam of length L = 1800 mm, fixed at x = 0 and free at x = L.
Use constant material and section properties: E = 200000 MPa and I = 1200000 mm⁴.
Apply a single downward point load P = 2000 N at the free end (x = L).
The internal bending moment varies linearly from PL at the fixed end to zero at the free end.
Compute the slope at the free end using θ = PL²/(2EI) and report it in radians and in degrees.
Compute the vertical deflection at the free end using δ = PL³/(3EI) and report it in mm.
Take downward deflection and clockwise rotation as positive.
Report the numerical results to at least four significant figures.
